notes: Hand-tuned from the player's own games: almost every 1v1 death came while a level down, behind in gold or down in farm, so the fight guard turns those into an explicit 'don't fight'. Jax spikes hard at level 6 (Grandmaster's Might) and with Trinity Force; after laning he wins most side-lane duels unless fed enemies can collapse.

motivation: Stay patient, stack your passive, and let Jax scale. You've got this.
